svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of people enrolled in tertiary education
Shown as the gross enrollment ratio — the number of people, regardless of their age, who are enrolled in tertiary
education, expressed as a percentage of the population of tertiary education age (typically 18–22 years).

tspan.tspan: Values may exceed 100% when children who are older or younger than the official age group also enroll.
